title: Medicaid Managed Care Membership Notice Channel Preferences
content:
## Notice channel preferences — questions and answers

These answers set out the Medicaid Managed Care Membership rule on the additional channel a member chooses for notices.

**Which channels may a member choose?** Text, email or mail, as the additional notice channel.

**Does choosing text or email stop mailed notices?** No. Mail is always used for legally required notices, whatever the choice.

**When does a changed preference take effect?** It applies to notices sent after the change. A notice already sent is never re-sent because the preference changed.

**What is needed for a text preference?** A phone number on the member profile. Without it, the preference stays unchanged.

**What is needed for an email preference?** An email address on the member profile. Without it, the preference stays unchanged.

### Summary table

| Preference asked for | Needed on the member profile | Without it |
|---|---|---|
| Text | Phone number | Preference stays unchanged |
| Email | Email address | Preference stays unchanged |
| Mail | — | — |

### Hypothetical case

A member whose profile holds an email address but no phone number asks to switch the additional channel to text. There is no phone number on the profile, so the preference stays as it was. The same member asking for email instead has an email address on file, so the preference changes, and it applies to notices sent after the change; notices already sent are not sent again.
